title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Members on Ridgeline Pro Credit — Payoff Accrual Tolerance
content:
**Clause.** On the payoff of a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account, the interim payoff accrual is reduced by the payoff accrual tolerance, never below zero. The tolerance is set by the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership:

| Membership carries a dedicated pro account representative | Net ProBuild qualifying spend in the last 12 months | Payoff accrual tolerance |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | At least 100000.00 | 40.00 (high payoff tolerance) |
| Yes | Below 100000.00 | 20.00 (low payoff tolerance) |
| No | Any | Zero |

## Reading the membership

- The membership is the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership in active status. Under Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards the dedicated pro account representative is a benefit of the ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum and ProBuild Platinum Elite tiers; the ProBuild Member, Bronze and Silver tiers carry none. A business with no active membership has no dedicated representative.
- The net spend is the ProBuild qualifying spend posted on the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards activity in the last 12 months, net of spend reversed in the same 12 months, the 12 months being whole calendar months counted back from the payment date.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Membership | Net spend | Interim accrual before the tolerance | Interim accrual after it |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Platinum | 140000.00 | 61.56 | 21.56 |
| ProBuild Gold | 60000.00 | 61.56 | 41.56 |
| ProBuild Gold | 60000.00 | 14.25 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| ProBuild Silver | 140000.00 | 61.56 | 61.56 |
